decision: Expose process-backed cluster lifecycle, IPC and deterministic SCHED_RR distribution for sandbox-local virtual TCP and HTTP listeners. No operating-system socket is opened.

processMapping.backend: GuestProcesses JavaScript child processes with advanced IPC
processMapping.reason: Node cluster workers are process identities with process.env, process.pid and process IPC semantics. The sandbox already models those properties in GuestProcesses.

unsupported: OS process and external socket claims
listenerBroker: The kernel-owned VirtualNetwork groups sibling cluster listener handles by primary process identity and port. It accepts each virtual connection once, dispatches in deterministic SCHED_RR order, removes closed or exited workers, and deletes the broker when its final listener closes.

resourceAccounting.network.listeners: logical bound ports, including one shared cluster broker per port
resourceAccounting.network.handles: worker listener handles plus accepted and client virtual sockets

nativeRequestDistributionControl.reason: Native Node cluster distribution requires binding an operating-system loopback socket. This task forbids host socket use, so request distribution is proven by the deterministic VirtualNetwork architecture test while the native fixture covers process event ordering without network I/O.
